description: Declared mutants of IP-3/IP-4 (ip3-declaration.md section 4). A mutant is killed only when its test run fails with the expected message. Run with docs/architecture/plans/time-threads-trace/scripts/run_mutations.py --catalog docs/architecture/plans/input-and-present/scripts/mutations.json. Platform and input tests need SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy in the runner's environment (they inherit it).

mutants.what: SdlPlatform.hpp includes SDL again (G1 must report it)
mutants.cases: SDL backend public headers do not reach any SDL header
mutants.expect: a non-native SDL backend header includes SDL

mutants.what: SdlPlatform.hpp includes SDL again (G2 must report it)
mutants.cases: Engine public headers outside the native layer name no SDL symbol
mutants.expect: SdlPlatform\.hpp:\d+ <SDL3/

mutants.what: SdlInput.hpp includes SDL_events.h again (G1 must report it)
mutants.cases: SDL backend public headers do not reach any SDL header
mutants.expect: a non-native SDL backend header includes SDL

mutants.what: SdlInput.hpp includes SDL_events.h again (G2 must report it)
mutants.cases: Engine public headers outside the native layer name no SDL symbol
mutants.expect: SdlInput\.hpp:\d+ <SDL3/

mutants.what: The clock pair is sampled once per process and reused by every pump
mutants.replace: const ValueScope<std::optional<ClockPair>> pair(impl_->pumpPair, [] { static const ClockPair once = SampleClockPair(); return once; }());
mutants.cases: Each pump converts with its own clock pair
mutants.expect: the second pump samples a new pair

mutants.what: A negative SDL-to-pair difference becomes zero
mutants.replace: const std::chrono::nanoseconds since{sdlNs >= pair.sdlNs ? static_cast<std::int64_t>(sdlNs - pair.sdlNs) : 0};
mutants.cases: ConvertSdlTimestamp places an SDL time relative to the clock pair
mutants.expect: an SDL time before the pair maps before

mutants.what: A negative SDL-to-pair difference becomes zero (integration)
mutants.replace: const std::chrono::nanoseconds since{sdlNs >= pair.sdlNs ? static_cast<std::int64_t>(sdlNs - pair.sdlNs) : 0};
mutants.cases: A pumped event carries the time it was pushed
mutants.expect: the event time is not later than its push

mutants.what: The SDL-to-pair difference is applied with the wrong sign
mutants.cases: ConvertSdlTimestamp places an SDL time relative to the clock pair
mutants.expect: an SDL time (before|after) the pair maps

mutants.what: The SDL-to-pair difference is applied with the wrong sign (integration)
mutants.cases: A pumped event carries the time it was pushed
mutants.expect: the event time is not later than its push

mutants.what: The converted time is not clamped to the delivery time
mutants.cases: ConvertSdlTimestamp never returns a time later than the ceiling
mutants.expect: a converted time later than the ceiling is the ceiling

mutants.what: The converted time is not clamped to the delivery time (integration)
mutants.cases: An SDL time in the future is delivered no later than its delivery
mutants.expect: a future SDL time is clamped to the delivery time

mutants.what: SDL time 0 is converted like any other time
mutants.find: if (sdlNs == 0) return ceiling;  // added without a time (SDL_PeepEvents)
mutants.cases: ConvertSdlTimestamp maps a missing SDL time to the delivery time
mutants.expect: SDL time 0 maps to the delivery time

mutants.what: A nested pump does not restore the outer pump's clock pair
mutants.cases: A nested pump samples its own clock pair*
mutants.expect: after a nested pump the outer pump

mutants.what: A nested pump reuses the outer pump's clock pair instead of sampling its own
mutants.cases: A nested pump samples its own clock pair*
mutants.expect: a nested pump samples its own pair

mutants.what: The pair is a fixed offset instead of a sample of both clocks
mutants.cases: Each pump converts with its own clock pair
mutants.expect: the second pump samples a new pair

mutants.what: The pair takes the first engine read instead of the midpoint
mutants.cases: MakeClockPair puts the engine time at the midpoint*
mutants.expect: the pair's engine time is the midpoint

mutants.what: The pair carries a 1 us bias
mutants.replace: return {engineBefore + (engineAfter - engineBefore) / 2 + std::chrono::microseconds(1), sdlNs, engineAfter - engineBefore};
mutants.cases: MakeClockPair puts the engine time at the midpoint*
mutants.expect: the pair's engine time is the midpoint

mutants.what: The pair reads SDL time in microseconds
mutants.cases: SampleClockPair reads both clocks*
mutants.expect: the pair's SDL time lies between

mutants.what: SampleClockPairWith takes the first engine read instead of the midpoint
mutants.cases: SampleClockPairWith reads Engine then SDL then Engine*
mutants.expect: the pair's engine time is the midpoint of its own reads

mutants.what: SampleClockPairWith passes the first engine read twice
mutants.cases: SampleClockPairWith reads Engine then SDL then Engine*
mutants.expect: the pair's engine time is the midpoint of its own reads

mutants.what: SampleClockPairWith passes the second engine read twice
mutants.cases: SampleClockPairWith reads Engine then SDL then Engine*
mutants.expect: the pair's engine time is the midpoint of its own reads

mutants.what: The SDL read happens after both engine reads
mutants.find:
const std::uint64_t sdl = readers.sdl();
    const Time::TimePoint after = readers.engine();
mutants.replace:
const Time::TimePoint after = readers.engine();
    const std::uint64_t sdl = readers.sdl();
mutants.cases: SampleClockPairWith reads Engine then SDL then Engine*
mutants.expect: the pair reads Engine, then SDL, then Engine
